driver_platform_url.name: Online driver search address
driver_platform_url.description: Address of the online driver search service (https://host/path, or http:// for a loopback host). Empty: the online search is not used and nothing is sent.
driver_platform_url.description[zh_CN]: 在线驱动搜索服务的地址（https://主机/路径；本机回环地址可用 http://）。留空：不使用在线搜索，也不会向外发送任何信息。
